summary: Turn-based mercenary tactics series spanning DOS classics, stand-alone expansions, remakes, online experiments, and modern console/PC revivals.

entries.title: Jagged Alliance
entries.definitive_edition: Jagged Alliance 1 Gold / modern PC DOSBox package

emulation.notes: Use a legal PC release bundled with DOSBox for the original game.

primary.version: Original PC release via modern storefront/DOSBox package
primary.why: The original PC version is the complete base game and is available through modern PC wrappers; the Nintendo DS version has altered content and cut features despite unique presentation changes.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original PC version through GOG/Steam or another legitimate DOSBox-backed release; check the DS version only for port-specific differences.

secondary.exclusive_content: Adapted DS presentation with new music and cinematic changes, but also removed mechanics and content.
secondary.what_to_play: Optional archival comparison only, not the main playthrough.
secondary.why: The DS port has unique presentation differences but is not the most complete version.

entries.remaster_caveats: The DS adaptation is not a definitive remaster; it changes and removes mechanics.

entries.title: Jagged Alliance: Deadly Games
entries.definitive_edition: Jagged Alliance 1 Gold / modern PC DOSBox package

emulation.notes: Use the bundled DOSBox setup from a modern PC release.

primary.version: Jagged Alliance 1 Gold / modern PC DOSBox package
primary.why: Deadly Games is a stand-alone DOS expansion/sequel, and the modern PC package is the complete playable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play through Jagged Alliance 1 Gold or another legitimate PC package that includes Deadly Games.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; this is a mission-focused stand-alone follow-up.

entries.title: Jagged Alliance 2
entries.definitive_edition: Jagged Alliance 2 Gold on Windows, with compatibility/community fixes as desired

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the primary route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PC visuals with optional community modernization.

primary.version: Jagged Alliance 2 Gold / current Windows PC release
primary.why: Windows is the original and most supported route, with modern storefront access and community compatibility/mod options; the Linux port has no exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release from GOG/Steam; use JA2 Stracciatella or other compatibility/mod paths only if they fit the archive goal.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remaster; community projects can modernize play but change the experience.

emulation.notes: Use modern storefront release or compatibility fixes as needed.

primary.why: Unfinished Business is a stand-alone Windows expansion for Jagged Alliance 2 and has no alternate platform with exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release after Jagged Alliance 2 if following the classic campaign chronology.

entries.title: Jagged Alliance 2: Wildfire

emulation.notes: Use modern storefront release or compatibility fixes as needed.

primary.why: Wildfire is a Windows-only stand-alone expansion/mod-derived release for Jagged Alliance 2, so the PC version is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release separately from Jagged Alliance 2; treat it as a variant campaign rather than the definitive version of JA2 itself.

entries.remaster_caveats: Wildfire is a stand-alone variant/expansion rather than a replacement for vanilla Jagged Alliance 2.

entries.title: Jagged Alliance: Back in Action
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with Shades of Red and Point Blank DLC

primary.version: Windows PC release with Shades of Red and Point Blank DLC
primary.why: Windows is the original and highest-fidelity route for this 3D Jagged Alliance 2 remake, with DLC availability and the most direct capture path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version and include the Shades of Red and Point Blank DLC if doing full content coverage.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a remake of Jagged Alliance 2's premise with major mechanical differences, not a faithful definitive replacement.

entries.title: Jagged Alliance: Crossfire

primary.why: Crossfire is a Windows-only stand-alone expansion to Back in Action, and PC is the only documented release platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release after Back in Action if covering its follow-up campaign.

entries.remaster_caveats: Stand-alone expansion to Back in Action, not a mainline sequel.

entries.title: Jagged Alliance Online
entries.definitive_edition: Jagged Alliance Online: Reloaded, historical only

emulation.emulator: Native Windows, if an owned archived client is usable
emulation.notes: Do not fabricate availability; official live play is not currently documented.

primary.version: Jagged Alliance Online: Reloaded historical Windows release
primary.why: The original browser service shut down and Reloaded was the later paid Windows re-release, making it the most complete historical form even though official live play is no longer available.
primary.how_to_play: There is no current official live-service route documented; use only a legally owned archived install for documentation, or cover it from public sources/footage.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service shutdown makes this an archival entry rather than a practical play recommendation.

entries.title: Jagged Alliance: Flashback

primary.why: Windows is the main release and best capture route for this reboot/prequel attempt; macOS and Linux have no exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Steam/GOG release if documenting the reboot branch; keep it separate from the classic continuity.

entries.remaster_caveats: Flashback is its own reboot/prequel branch, not a remaster of Jagged Alliance 2.

entries.title: Jagged Alliance: Rage!

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity release and has no content gap against the PS4/Xbox One versions.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version for capture; use console versions only for controller/console comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Rage is a smaller spin-off set after the classic games, not a mainline sequel.

entries.title: Jagged Alliance 3

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with current patch/mod support.

primary.why: Windows has the highest-fidelity route, mouse/keyboard controls, modding/tool support, and no content loss versus the console ports.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release through Steam/GOG/Epic; use consoles only if specifically comparing controller UI or living-room play.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern mainline sequel rather than a remake; keep separate from Back in Action and Flashback.
